description:
Score sheets
Result lists for the following games:

- Rummy
- Sixty-Six
- popular game Sk... King (Pirates)
- popular game Wizard®
- dice game Y...zee (Pasch)

Features
- up to 8 players
- unlimited predefined player names
- Rummy: add double score wih one click
- automatic calculation
- dealer indicator

Remarks
I made this Android app for my own private use. Maybe someone else will find it useful.
